verdicts_or_reports.expected: Restoring both photos returns the original single IrisSeed album with 2 items.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After restoring both original photos, Albums shows two IrisSeed cards with 1 items each. Reopening and rotating preserves the split; opening the first shows only huge.jpg.
steps: Start with IrisSeed containing huge.jpg and big.jpg.
Delete big.jpg from its album viewer, then huge.jpg from Media.
Open Library > Trash and restore huge.jpg, then restore big.jpg.
Open Albums: two IrisSeed cards each show 1 items.
Open the first card, leave and return via Media and Albums, rotate and go back: the two cards remain.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: One IrisSeed card containing both photos from /storage/emulated/0/Pictures/IrisSeed/.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Reproduced a second full delete/restore cycle: two IrisSeed cards remain, each labeled 1 items, first huge.jpg and second big.jpg. The second opens a one-photo album. Details confirms big.jpg remains in the original IrisSeed path.
steps: Media: open big.jpg and tap Delete.
Media: open remaining huge.jpg and tap Delete.
Library > Trash shows huge.jpg then big.jpg.
Tap remaining big.jpg, tap Restore selected.
Tap Albums bottom tab: two IrisSeed cards appear, each 1 items. Reproduced twice; navigate away and back or rotate and they persist.

verdicts_or_reports.observed: Both single-photo IrisSeed album cards show the plural caption “1 items”; observed after deletion and again after restoration and rotation.
steps: Delete big.jpg from the two-photo IrisSeed album.
Return to Albums: remaining single-photo album says 1 items.
Restore photos via Trash and revisit Albums; single-photo cards still say 1 items.

sign_off.notes: Swept Media, album browsing/covers, and Trash using both seeded photos. Checked empty/populated states, filters/search including unusual input and clearing, details sizes 1.5 MB/2.5 MB, navigation, rotation, repeated delete/restore, newest-trash-first ordering, and cancellation of individual permanent deletion and Empty Trash. Both photos restored; Trash empty; Media shows both. Observed and reported split IrisSeed cards after restoration twice, plus singular count caption '1 items'; developer replied could not reproduce to reports. No permanent deletion performed. Album grouping remains split as reported.
